# VS Code Dark

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-dark)
[![npm downloads](https://img.shields.io/npm/dt/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-dark)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-dark)

VS Code Dark is a **dark** CodeMirror 6 theme whose text colors all meet WCAG AA contrast. It belongs to the VS Code family.

[Open in playground](../../playground/theme-gallery/) to compare it with the other themes.

## Install

```bash
npm install @fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-dark codemirror
```

The theme is also exported as `vsCodeDark` by `@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-bundle`.

## Usage

```ts
import { basicSetup, EditorView } from 'codemirror';
import { vsCodeDark } from '@fsegurai/codemirror-theme-vscode-dark';

new EditorView({
  doc: 'const answer = 42;',
  extensions: [basicSetup, vsCodeDark],
  parent: document.body,
});
```

| Export | Type |
|---|---|
| `vsCodeDark` | `Extension` |
| `vsCodeDarkMergeStyles` | `IMergeRevertStyles` |
| `applyMergeRevertStyles` | `(styles: IMergeRevertStyles) => void` |

## Editor surfaces

Translucent colors are composited over the background, which is the color text is measured against.

| Surface | Color |
|---|---|
| Background | `#1e1e1e` |
| Active line | `#252525` |
| Selection | `#22384e` |

## Syntax colors

Resolved highlight styles for common [Lezer tags](https://lezer.codemirror.net/docs/ref/#highlight.tags) and their contrast ratio. WCAG AA requires 4.5:1 for text; the lowest ratio of this theme, over all tags, is 4.53:1 on the selection.

| Role | Tag | Color | Style | On background | On active line | On selection |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Keyword | `keyword` | `#5fa5df` | bold | 6.30:1 | 5.79:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Control keyword | `controlKeyword` | `#c98ac4` | bold | 6.28:1 | 5.78:1 | 4.54:1 |
| Operator | `operator` | `#d4d4d4` | - | 11.25:1 | 10.34:1 | 8.12:1 |
| Punctuation | `punctuation` | `#d4d4d4` | - | 11.25:1 | 10.34:1 | 8.12:1 |
| Variable | `variableName` | `#9cdcfe` | - | 11.18:1 | 10.28:1 | 8.08:1 |
| Variable definition | `definition(variableName)` | `#9cdcfe` | - | 11.18:1 | 10.28:1 | 8.08:1 |
| Function call | `function(variableName)` | `#dcdcaa` | - | 11.80:1 | 10.85:1 | 8.52:1 |
| Property | `propertyName` | `#9cdcfe` | - | 11.18:1 | 10.28:1 | 8.08:1 |
| Type | `typeName` | `#4ec9b0` | - | 8.18:1 | 7.52:1 | 5.91:1 |
| Class | `className` | `#4ec9b0` | - | 8.18:1 | 7.52:1 | 5.91:1 |
| Namespace | `namespace` | `#d4d4d4` | - | 11.25:1 | 10.34:1 | 8.12:1 |
| String | `string` | `#ce9178` | - | 6.31:1 | 5.80:1 | 4.56:1 |
| Regular expression | `regexp` | `#eb807f` | - | 6.29:1 | 5.79:1 | 4.55:1 |
| Number | `number` | `#b5cea8` | - | 9.81:1 | 9.02:1 | 7.09:1 |

| Constant | `constant(variableName)` | `#9cdcfe` | - | 11.18:1 | 10.28:1 | 8.08:1 |

## Editor UI colors

Non-text indicators need 3:1 (WCAG 1.4.11). The selection must stay distinguishable on the active line (1.15:1 or more).

| Element | Selector | Color | Measured against | Ratio | Result |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Text | `&` | `#d4d4d4` | background, active line, selection | 8.12:1 | Pass |
| Line numbers | `.cm-gutters` | `#9f9f9f` | gutter | 6.44:1 | Pass |
| Cursor | `.cm-cursor` | `#c6c6c6` | background, active line | 8.97:1 | Pass |
| Focus ring | `&.cm-focused` | `#9f9f9f` | background | 6.30:1 | Pass |
| Matching bracket outline | `.cm-matchingBracket` | `1px solid #5fa5df99` | background, active line | 3.00:1 | Pass |
| Current search match | `.cm-searchMatch-selected` | `#54a1fd90, 1px solid #5fa5df99` | background (fill or outline) | 3.13:1 | Pass |
| Selection | `.cm-selectionBackground` | `#264f7889` | active line | 1.27:1 | Pass |
